name: Chickpea, chorizo & spinach stew
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food / similar stew recipes with these quantities (serves 4 adults as a main with bread).
Total time is sum of explicit step times (onion 3-4 min + veg 2-3 min + simmer 1-2 min) plus ~5 min for chopping/prep and ~3 min for wilting/seasoning; rounded conservatively.

Gluten-free is null because recipe specifies serving with crusty bread (wheat unless certified GF) and sherry vinegar is sometimes aged in wheat barrels; no explicit gluten ingredients but cross-contact possible.
Dairy-free true: no milk, cheese, butter or other dairy listed.
Chorizo makes it non-vegetarian/vegan/pescatarian; all other ingredients plant-based.
No tree nuts, peanuts, soy, eggs, fish, shellfish, milk or sesame in listed ingredients.
instructions:
step 1
Heat the oil in a large pan, then gently fry the onion for 3-4 mins until it begins to soften. Stir in the carrot, celery, thyme and bay leaves. Season, then cook for 2-3 mins, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic, chorizo, cinnamon and smoked paprika. Gently fry until the vegetables soften and the chorizo starts to release its oils and crisp up.

step 2
Stir in the chickpeas, vinegar and 150ml water, then bring to a simmer for 1-2 mins until the chickpeas have heated up. Add the spinach, then stir through the chickpeas until it wilts a little. Remove from the heat, season to taste, then serve warm with crusty bread.

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: 3 sprigs fresh thyme, leaves and stem (typical small bunch per sprig)

ingredients.name: Chorizo
ingredients.assumptions: 200g chorizo sausage as listed (cured, typical cured Spanish variety)

ingredients.name: Chickpeas
ingredients.assumptions: 800g can chickpeas, drained weight approx 60% of can (standard drained yield)

ingredients.name: Sherry vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tbsp sherry vinegar (standard 15ml per tbsp, low-calorie vinegar)
